'''Ladd''' was a [[Private/Legends|private]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the [[Galactic War]] Ladd was killed on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], near the [[Lower City Hydro Station]], which Ladd and 3 other privates attempted to sabotage.
